recognize_zh: 骨髓切片可見體積很大、雙核或多核的漿細胞（偏位核、細胞質豐富嗜雙性），抹片中也有巨大多核細胞與不典型漿細胞，CD138膜染色勾勒出成群大型漿細胞，符合移植後EBV相關漿細胞骨髓瘤型PTLD。
features: Large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei, and frequent binucleation or multinucleation (A)
Aspirate with a giant multinucleated cell and scattered atypical plasmacytoid cells among hematopoietic elements (B, C)
Strong membranous CD138-like staining outlining large neoplastic plasma cells in clusters (D; marker not labeled)
Weaker, patchy staining of a subset of cells on a second immunostain (E; marker not labeled)
H&E field with interstitial infiltrate adjacent to vessels/fat (F); low resolution limits detail
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows an infiltrate of large atypical plasma cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and frequent bi- or multinucleation. The aspirate smears contain scattered atypical plasmacytoid cells and occasional giant multinucleated forms. Immunostains highlight clusters of large neoplastic plasma cells with strong membranous staining and a second marker staining a subset (antibodies not labeled in the figure). Resolution limits evaluation of nucleoli and inclusions. In a transplant recipient, and with EBV demonstration, findings are consistent with monomorphic post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder of plasma cell myeloma type with large multinucleated plasma cells.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm and are CD61/CD42b positive and CD138 negative, unlike multinucleated plasma cells with perinuclear hof.
Plasmablastic lymphoma consists of sheets of immunoblast-like cells with very high Ki-67 and usually presents as an extramedullary mass rather than marrow-based mature plasma cell morphology.
Reactive plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic for kappa and lambda, without multinucleated giant forms.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters and are cytokeratin positive, lacking cytoplasmic immunoglobulin light chain.
